isolation_policy: phase 1 isolated; phase 2 receives phase 1 final outputs only

open_risks.risk: Invalid labels from hidden/off-image geometry or simulator artifacts.
open_risks.mitigation: Block release unless every case has non-null oracle_trace_path, visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, fov_supported=true, requires_hidden_geometry=false, and audit images.

open_risks.risk: False novelty if simple heuristics match VLM or human performance.
open_risks.mitigation: Before claims, run blind, majority, radius-only, action-only, center-ray, corridor-width, and largest-floor-patch baselines.

open_risks.risk: T4 answer-space leakage from monotonic body-size physics.
open_risks.mitigation: Report a monotonic-smaller-body baseline, randomize body order, include no-flip controls, and consider asking two independent yes/no body queries instead of one four-way MCQ.

open_risks.risk: Body-width normalization may not remove monocular scale ambiguity from RGB alone.
open_risks.mitigation: Require human sanity, M2b sweep-overlay improvement, and M3 depth-probe results before claiming RGB-local consequence reasoning.

open_risks.risk: T5 is near-redundant with thresholded T1 and may make the benchmark look like a wall-hit detector.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep T5 as a small extension; lead with T1/T2/T4 and use body/action counterfactual pairs.

open_risks.risk: Template-authored examples could be mistaken for benchmark cases in the HTML deliverables.
open_risks.mitigation: Set every current case review to revise; show only simulator-backed reviewed cases, or badge placeholders as not_simulator_validated and keep them out of scoring.

open_risks.risk: A live --runner codex design/HTML round would polish placeholders instead of producing evidence.
open_risks.mitigation: Route to pipeline_verify to generate data_manifest.json, geometry labels, visibility metrics, and visual assets before HTML case review.

open_risks.risk: Hidden or off-image geometry can silently determine labels, especially for T3 and T5.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep T3/T5 extension-only unless visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, fov_supported=true, requires_hidden_geometry=false, and decisive collision evidence is visible.

open_risks.risk: Shortcut baselines may solve drafted cases without swept-volume reasoning.
open_risks.mitigation: Run blind, majority, radius-only, action-only, center-ray, largest-floor-patch, and corridor-width heuristics before empirical claims.

open_risks.risk: T4 can be gamed by monotonic small-body priors.
open_risks.mitigation: Randomize Body A/B order, include flip and no-flip controls, and report counterfactual-pair consistency.

open_risks.risk: False novelty if the benchmark is described as new collision geometry or broad spatial intelligence.
open_risks.mitigation: State that swept-cylinder collision is the deterministic label engine; the contribution is single-frame ego-body action-consequence diagnosis.
